commit_invariants: one fixed contiguous source range per job
source hash is revalidated from raw L0 under the subject lock
immutable chunk insert and expected-version checkpoint advance share one transaction
same candidate replay is idempotent and competing content/source fails closed
failure never advances projection_watermark or mutates L0
read_invariants: all current-generation chunk ranges are contiguous from seq 1
last_chunk_id and projection_watermark identify the final current-generation chunk
source hashes are checked against raw L0
uncovered ranges are represented by source/projection watermarks and never hidden by a read cap
